description_html:
The VOOPOO PnP X Coil is a replacement coil for compatible VOOPOO devices.

  • Product Type: Replacement Coil
  • Coil Resistance: 0.15Ω / 0.2Ω / 0.3Ω / 0.6Ω
  • Coil Material: Mesh
  • Compatible Devices: VOOPOO Drag 4 / 5 / 6, Drag S2 / X2 / S3 / X3, Drag M100s, Vinci E120 / Spark100, Argus Pro 2, Doric 60 Pro, UFORCE-X / UFORCE-X 2 / Nano tanks
  • Pack Quantity: 5 Coils
  • Brand: VOOPOO

Coils are consumable - replace when flavour or vapour output drops.

Available options: 0.15 OHM, 0.2 OHM, 0.3 OHM, 0.6 OHM.
